paper.title: NucleoNet: A Nuclear-Aware Determinant Ansatz for Multi-Geometry Neural Variational Monte Carlo
paper.authors: Qiao Gao, Yang Huang, Enze Hou, Yuzhi Liu, Jingrun Chen, Han Wang

results.system_description: N2 at bond length 2.068 bohr, all electrons, singlet (7 up, 7 down), clamped nuclei
results.eligibility_evidence: VMC energy of the trained single-geometry network as printed; the paper does not describe a separate evaluation run.
results.notes: Geometry 'taken from the FermiNet benchmark protocol' (Sec. III of the Supplementary Material), i.e. 2.068 bohr. Parameter count printed as 0.14M. The other columns of Table S3 re-quote earlier papers. The multi-geometry runs (Table S5, e.g. 2.0645 bohr) are other geometries.

results.system_description: Methylamine at the G3 geometry, all electrons, singlet (9 up, 9 down), clamped nuclei
results.eligibility_evidence: VMC energy of the trained single-geometry network as printed; the paper does not describe a separate evaluation run.
results.notes: Geometry 'taken from the FermiNet benchmark protocol' (Sec. III of the Supplementary Material). The compact configuration (h1, h2) = (64, 16) is used for all equilibrium small-molecule benchmarks. The other columns of Table S3 re-quote earlier papers. Table X of Pfau et al. labels the coordinates 'Position (a_0)', but they are in angstrom (C-N 1.464, C-H 1.100; in bohr the C-N bond would be 0.77 angstrom), and the instance stores them in angstrom; the energies near CCSD(T)/CBS confirm the angstrom geometry.

results.system_description: NH₃ at the G3 geometry, all electrons, singlet (5 up, 5 down), clamped nuclei
results.eligibility_evidence: Absolute variational energy of the single-geometry ablation network, 'used in the ablation analysis' (Supplementary Material, Raw Ablation Data); 'values in parentheses denote the statistical uncertainty in the last reported digit'.
results.notes: Ablation variant of NucleoNet in which the envelope parameters no longer depend on the final nuclear representations (Supplementary Material, ablation section). Geometry as for Table S3. The 'NucleoNet' column of Table S12 repeats the Table S3 value.
